 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Internacional and Coritiba face off at Beira-Rio at 9:30 p.m. (Brasília time) this Tuesday (3) in Matchday 34 of the 2026 Brasileirão.
 Colorado are languishing in third-to-last place (18th) with just 35 points, but a win would lift them out of the relegation zone, as Grêmio and Mirassol both have 37 points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Coxa, meanwhile, sit 11th in the table with 42 points and are virtually safe from a return to Série B.
 That is because Coritiba are coming off a 2-0 win over Vitória in the previous round.
 Compared with the last match (a 2-1 defeat to Fluminense), coach Eduardo Baptista has brought Mercado, Villagra, Carbonero and Vitinho into Inter's lineup in place of Maripán, Ronaldo, Bernabéi and Alan Patrick, respectively.
